# SWAYA — Complete Product Manual & Architecture Specification

> SWAYA is an offline-first desktop media center and batch file organizer engineered exclusively for Windows 10 and 11 x64 systems.

---

## 1. System Architecture & Privacy Model

- **Platform**: Native Windows 10/11 desktop application packaged with Electron, React, and embedded MPV.
- **Database Engine**: Local embedded SQLite database stored on disk at `data/swaya.db`.
- **Zero Cloud & Zero Telemetry**: SWAYA does not require user accounts, cloud syncing, remote servers, or background telemetry. All personal collections, watch states, ratings, and tags remain strictly on the user's local disk.
- **Licensing**: Perpetual offline license with one-time payment (€39 introductory price). Supports activation on up to 3 personal Windows devices. Cryptographic validation uses HMAC-SHA256 offline tokens.

---

## 2. Core Functional Modules

### A. Smart Batch File Organizer (`/docs/organizer`)
- Automatically parses disorganized filenames using advanced regex pattern matchers.
- Scrapes metadata directly from online APIs (TMDb, OMDb, StashDB, FansDB, ThePornDB).
- Renames physical video files and moves them into standardized folder hierarchies (`{Title} ({Year})/{Title} ({Year}) - {Resolution}.{ext}`).
- Provides safe, non-destructive "Dry Run" simulations with duplicate/collision prevention before applying changes to disk.

### B. Unified Media Library & Catalog (`/docs/library`)
- Consolidated browsing interface for Movies, TV Shows, Episodes, Scenes, Performers/Actors, and Studios.
- Full offline capability: External USB hard drives and network NAS folders remain indexed and searchable even when unplugged.
- Granular 10-star rating system, personal markdown review notes, and custom tagging.

### C. Embedded High-Performance 4K MPV Player (`/docs/player`)
- GPU-accelerated video rendering powered by libmpv.
- Native support for HDR10, Dolby Vision tonemapping, ASS/SSA complex stylized subtitles, and multi-track audio switching.
- Instant resume timestamps, chapter navigation, and automatic playback history logging.

### D. Custom Themed Lists & Smart Collections (`/docs/lists`)
- Create curated lists with custom descriptions and manual ordering.
- Dynamic auto-generated 4-poster collage cover art for all user-created collections.

### E. 1-Click Stealth Vault & Privacy Controls (`/docs/settings`)
- Global hotkey (`Ctrl+Alt+H` or `Esc`) instantly hides sensitive media libraries and restores a neutral workspace.
- Vault collections can be PIN/password-protected with zero trace left in recent files.

### F. Integrated Torrent Client Dashboards (`/docs/torrent`)
- Remote web API control for qBittorrent, Transmission, and Deluge.
- Unified search and real-time download monitoring directly within the media center.

---

## 3. Product Comparisons & Competitive Landscape

- **vs FileBot**: SWAYA combines physical disk batch renaming with a full 4K playback engine and offline visual media library.
- **vs Plex / Jellyfin**: SWAYA requires zero server setup, zero transcoding CPU/GPU load, and zero network configuration; it plays files directly from local storage.
- **vs tinyMediaManager**: Modern high-DPI GPU-rendered user interface with built-in video player.
- **vs StashApp**: Standalone lightweight desktop app with native MPV integration rather than local web server architecture.
